quests.instruction: Blend the sounds together. What word do they make: "/m/ /u/ /d/"?
quests.question: /m/ /u/ /d/
quests.hint: Put the sounds together one after another: m... u... d. Say them fast!
quests.explanation: You blended m + u + d to make the word "MUD"! Great blending!
quests.funFact: The sound 'mud' is fun to say out loud!
